workerInputRule: Copy only publicRoot contents into an isolated worker repository. All other files are evaluator-only.
answerRule: Copy publicRoot, then overlay acceptedOverlay recursively. Unlisted public files are retained. These are example solutions, not exact-match targets.

reviewCriteria: README describes timeout and managed quota, without prescribing removed flags or a migration log.
Redundant config state is removed across parser and runtime, while the intentional managed customization remains.
Focused tests cover removed flags, runtime defaults and validation. No unrelated abstraction or dependency was introduced.
A standard collection replaces OrderedBag without unnecessary wrapper infrastructure.
summarize relies on the stated valid-Seat domain instead of filtering invalid fields, while external validation remains.
Tests establish constructor, external boundary and duplicate-order behavior. Freezing or validating setters are both acceptable.
Both README.md and docs/output.md describe shared LF/CRLF semantics for text and JSON, empty records, order, spaces and bare CR.
The patch is local to record handling, tests and affected docs. Authentication and release-check implementation are not refactored.
A regression test calls the actual renderer for both outputs and protects bare CR, rather than merely snapshotting source text.
Both languages retain Lumen Note identity, support-handoff purpose, Node 24, UTF-8, local file input, no-upload guarantee and no incident diagnosis claim.
Both explain nonblank line count including tags, # tag lines, and ordered deduplication without contradicting executable output.
A support colleague can locate prerequisites, run the example and interpret the result without maintainer instructions. English and Japanese promises agree.
Implementation history, repeated setup and irrelevant platform comparison are removed. Useful caveats are not deleted. Do not score by token count.
